_comment: Canonical listing store. Statuses reflect VERIFICATION state. A listing may only be 'match' when confirmed present in live MLS-backed active inventory (see README 'Verification gate'). Search-engine snippets are NOT a valid source of status.

dataSource.name: Coldwell Banker IDX (MetroList MLS)
dataSource.coverage: All 406 active+pending listings across Shingle Springs (62), Rescue (52) and Placerville (292); every active 4BR+/3BA+ single-family home at or under $1.5M was opened individually to read structured lot acreage and agent remarks.
dataSource.note: Acreage is read from the structured lotSizeAcres field. Pool presence is read from the agent's public remarks, because this feed carries no structured pool flag — each was reviewed by hand to exclude 'room to add a pool' and decorative ponds.

dataQuality.note: Network egress opened up for this run, so live MLS-backed listing pages were readable for the first time. Every property below was confirmed present in active inventory on 2026-10-31 with a 2026 MLS number, satisfying the verification gate. All six properties carried over from the 2026-07-26 run were absent from active inventory and have been dropped.

listings.blurb: European Country-inspired estate built as the builder's own residence, on 40 acres with sweeping Sierra foothill views — by far the most land on this list. Private resort-style backyard with an artistic hand-carved rock saltwater pool designed to mimic local river watering holes, with a rock waterfall, mature landscaping and fruit trees. Soaring ceilings, walls of windows, granite kitchen with double warming ovens and walk-in pantry, multiple living and dining spaces, and a dedicated movie theater room.
listings.flag: Status conflict: Coldwell Banker's live MetroList feed shows ACTIVE at $1,389,000 (136 days on market), but one brokerage site lists it as a pocket/exclusive listing marked inactive at $1,489,000. Confirm with the listing office (Real Broker Technologies) before planning a visit.

listings.blurb: Gated luxury estate on 16.74 acres atop Bedford Canyon, with panoramic sunrise-to-stargazing views and a private road. Resort-style infinity-edge pool with waterfall and spa. 5 bedrooms, 3 full baths, office, bonus family/game room, formal dining, and a gourmet kitchen with 5-burner gas range, double oven and Sub-Zero. Fully permitted for short-term rental (Airbnb), and the lot has room for an additional home.

listings.blurb: Ten-acre sanctuary minutes from town. Resort-style backyard with sparkling pool, spa, waterfall feature and a gazebo housing a full outdoor kitchen. Updated throughout: quartz kitchen with stainless appliances, family room with soaring ceilings and woodstove, upstairs game room with wet bar, spa-inspired primary walk-in shower with dual vanities. Wide-plank hardwood, leased solar, whole-house generator. Room for agricultural or equestrian use.

listings.listingOffice: eXp Realty Of Northern California, Inc.
listings.blurb: Custom two-story home on nearly six acres at the end of the road, in a sought-after Rescue area minutes from shopping and schools. Stunning built-in pool bordered by mature flowers and greenery. Four bedrooms (one downstairs), three baths, formal dining, separate living and family rooms. Plus a ~750 sqft entertainment hub above the detached 3-car garage — game room, extra room and bath, joined to the house by a breezeway. Fenced areas, loafing shed, and Sacramento valley views.
listings.flag: Marked "Major price reduction" by the listing agent — earlier third-party sources carried $1,199,900–$1,225,000.

listings.blurb: Single-story custom home on 5 private acres with sweeping hillside views. The standout is an infinity-edge saltwater pool and spa overlooking the hills, with expansive travertine decking, a dedicated outdoor shower and pool bathroom. Chef's kitchen, engineered wood floors, Andersen dual-pane windows, whole-house fan, 4-car garage. A separate living area with its own bedroom, full bath and private entrance works as guest or multigenerational space. Matterport tour available.

listings.blurb: Custom Milton Estates pool home on 5 usable acres with great views and many fruit trees. Great-room concept with abundant natural light, owned solar, granite kitchen with Viking range and large island. Living room with pellet stove and French doors to the covered patio. Primary suite has a screened porch and is prewired for a spa. A ~1,000 sqft lower level (not in the stated square footage) adds 2 bedrooms, full bath, living area and office with a new kitchenette — ideal in-law quarters. Detached 30x24 workshop plus cement RV pad with hookups.

listings.blurb: Gated mini-ranch with an ADU on 5 acres at the end of a paved driveway. Sparkling in-ground pool, landscaped grounds and owned solar. Single-story ranch layout with vaulted ceilings and picture windows, updated granite kitchen with stainless appliances and a large island/dining bar. Primary suite with vaulted ceilings and fireplace, plus a flexible adjoining room for office or studio. Expansive deck with pergola, ceiling fans, lighting and a full outdoor kitchen.

listings.blurb: Foothill property set up for swimming, gardening and gathering on 5 acres. Pool with an outdoor shower and a basic pool house already in place, plus two greenhouses, veggie beds, a large chicken coop, irrigation and abundant fruit and nut trees. Two-story main home with a private ground-level guest suite (own entrance and full bath), two-car garage and full basement. Primary suite with soaking tub and stone-mosaic walk-in shower. A detached 2-bed/1-bath guest cottage with kitchenette adds separate living space.

listings.blurb: The cheapest way onto this list, and the one with the biggest caveats. Gorgeous in-ground pool with natural rock features and screening vegetation, a balcony deck overlooking the pool and barn area, in one of the area's better neighborhoods.
listings.flag: Two caveats. The 2.66 acres is an assemblage of a 1.39-acre primary parcel plus a flat 1.3-acre second parcel that can be sold or developed separately — the home parcel alone is under your 2.5-acre minimum. The listing also states the home needs work and will not qualify for VA/FHA financing.
